statement: The emotional peak falls in the last third of the book in 5 of 7 analysed books; Grumpy Cloud and An Unexpected Adventure reach their first peak at the midpoint and plateau.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2025)

analyst_note: 2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. The wordless journey peaks at page 6 and holds through page 9 before a quiet return: a second plateau shape.

magicpaper.suggested: Check where MagicPaper arcs place their most intense page; compare after the corpus grows.
magicpaper.note: Emotion intensity is an analyst judgment per page.
